description: Change a draft at the revision you read. If someone changed it since, nothing is written and the 409 names the revision it is at now: read it again first. A reply's recipient and mailbox can't change.

fileIds.description: The stored files attached to the draft, in order, up to 10 ids. Replaces the draft's current list; an empty list removes every file. A repeated id counts once.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: update_draft
title: Change a draft
